comparison.objective: Arrange four cots with prescribed spacing and alternating pillow orientation; candidate commissions an impact damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pick-and-place and spatial layout versus fine tool insertion, bounded torque, rotary adjustment, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Cots separated by at least 9.2 cm at scale, head-to-toe, unstacked and untipped versus bounded physical impact behavior over two cycles.
comparison.reason: Spatial arrangement does not test adjustment, locking, or force-controlled damper commissioning.
